title: Introduction to Cognitive Bias — Crash Course Scientific Thinking #1
skills: define cognitive bias and explain how it can influence judgment
identify common ways prior beliefs and mental shortcuts affect reasoning
evaluate claims and evidence with awareness of potential bias
apply critical-thinking strategies to reduce biased interpretation
alignment_note: Introduces cognitive bias and explains how mental shortcuts, expectations, and prior beliefs can influence reasoning and interpretation. Supports critical reading, source evaluation, argument analysis, research literacy, and reflective thinking across high school English and interdisciplinary inquiry.
